scientific_integrity.proof: Exact cyclotomic singular equations and Hessian rank; classical dual multiplicity formula; explicit automorphism stabilizer.
scientific_integrity.verification: Standalone deterministic exact checker, no external downloads or experimental extrapolation.

scientific_limitations: Exhibits one 1280-element dual orbit; no global maximality/exhaustive classification. The Jacobi–Madden quartic equation was previously known, and the 2008 original full text could not be inspected. Does not establish a new moduli class or independent audit.
title: An orbit of 1,280 multiplicity-twelve points on the dual Fermat quartic threefold
